review_status: All concepts require clinical, rights and accessibility review

briefs.title: Organ development during pregnancy
briefs.caption: Development across gestational week ranges
briefs.alt: The early nervous system and heart form before later maturation of the lungs and mineral storage.
briefs.render: Highlight the entire source window. An event spanning four weeks must not appear as four independent events.

briefs.title: Two timelines after birth
briefs.caption: Maternal recovery and child development can progress on different schedules.
briefs.alt: Separate parent and infant tracks share the date of birth, then have independently reviewed topics.
briefs.render: Link the existing maternal phases without inferring recovery milestones. Place urgent actions above both tracks.

briefs.title: Six motor windows
briefs.caption: Ages at attainment varied among children in the WHO reference sample.
briefs.alt: Walking alone ranged from 8.2 to 17.6 months between the first and 99th percentiles; the other skills also have overlapping ranges.
briefs.render: Horizontal range bars in months; distinguish percentile windows from confidence intervals. No red deadline or ranking.

briefs.title: Kangaroo care in neonatal units
briefs.caption: Mortality in two hospital trials, shown at their own follow-up times.
briefs.alt: The multicountry trial reported fewer deaths at 28 days; the Ugandan estimate also favored early care but its interval includes no difference.
briefs.render: Show event counts and denominators per arm; forest panels for 28 days, 7 days and 72 hours. Log ratio axis at 1. No pooled diamond.

briefs.title: Early peanut introduction
briefs.caption: Allergy at age five among selected high-risk infants, by entry skin-test group.
briefs.alt: Among initially skin-test-negative infants, 13.7% with avoidance and 1.9% with consumption developed allergy.
briefs.render: Show arm percentages and difference in percentage points with CI. Accompany with clinician review pathway.

briefs.title: Daily intake references
briefs.caption: Dietary reference intakes across age bands and lactation.
briefs.alt: The table distinguishes an adequate intake from a recommended dietary allowance and identifies the unit for every nutrient.
briefs.render: Keep maternal and child series separate. No dose conversion, compliance score or infant water-volume recommendation.

briefs.title: Recognizing urgent illness
briefs.caption: When a young infant needs immediate medical attention
briefs.alt: Text connects breathing difficulty with blue lips or unresponsiveness to emergency services.
briefs.render: Warnings must work in text, without color or an illustration. No skin-tone-based diagnosis or child photos.
